create-a-wallet-into-an-encrypted-vault.text: Create a wallet into an encrypted vault. Issue 638, the first of five tickets under issue 490.

story.text: Alice creates her wallet with singular into a passphrase-encrypted vault and sees her address. Her key never exists as a plain file, and she never installs cardano-cli. She can print the address again by typing the passphrase.

requirements.text: The vault is an age file with a passphrase recipient. Every creation draws a fresh key. An existing path is never overwritten. The printed address is the enterprise address of the key. A wrong or empty passphrase is refused without leaking anything. The passphrase is never an argument. Loading a plain key file is unchanged, and no cardano-cli or node component is linked.

refusals.text: Every refusal exits non-zero, prints nothing on standard output and names its cause on standard error.

observable-success.text: Unit specs run in the job that runs the focused off-chain suite. The packaged binary controls run in the job for documented flags and refusal controls. The Lean model is silent on key custody.
